sets.name: Identity Mismatch Demo
sets.description: 3 synthetic documents (Aadhaar, PAN, Birth Certificate) demonstrating a name mismatch between PAN and the other two documents, plus a year-only DOB on the Birth Certificate.
sets.scenario: Consensus on name from Aadhaar + Birth Certificate, PAN has a different spelling. Full DOB on Aadhaar & PAN, year-only on Birth Certificate.
